{{Quote|Hey, to me an explosion is an explosion.''"<br />"''Yes. But to me, a human is a human.|[[Samuel Raider]] and Speedy|<ref name="OSG" />}}
"'''Speedy'''" was the nickname of a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who served aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was called Speedy by the other pilots as they could not pronounce his real name.<ref name="OSG" />

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Speedy completed his training and entered active duty, successfully completing two missions shortly after [[Operation Strike Fear]]. The Sullustan was present in the pilot's lounge of the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] for a conversation between [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] pilots about their preferred [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] targets, with Speedy mentioning his particular dislike for [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]]. A cultural divide separated the Sullustan pilot from Red Squadron, with his fellow [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] understanding neither his jokes nor his references to [[scarns]].<ref name="OSG" />

Despite this, Speedy returned to the company of Red Squadron's pilots in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] after receiving special reconnaissance training due to his Sullustan navigational skills, witnessing [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander's]] attempt to use a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on [[Samuel Raider]] and recruitment of rookie pilots such as [[Casal Marskan]] with promises of power through the Force. After Marskan's [[Death/Legends|death]], Speedy, along with Raider and [[Ernek Marskan|Marskan's brother]], grew to distrust and hate Farlander, alienating him from his fellow pilots.<ref name="OSG" />
